Previously, you could only share a document publicly or with a list of individual account IDs. ...

change_items.title: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) now supports Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6)

change_items.summary: AWS CodeConnections now allows you to securely share your Connection resource across individual AWS accounts or within your AWS Organization. facts.claim: A sharing account can have at most 250 pending invitations by default; the quota applies only to accounts sharing with accounts outside their AWS organization, a receiving account has no quota on pending invitations, and invitations are not used when sharing within an organization that has resource sharing turned on.

qualifiers.condition: only for sharing with accounts outside the same organization

evidence.title: Service quotas for AWS RAM
evidence.quote:
| Maximum number of pending invitations per sharing account + This quota applies to only **sending** accounts who are sharing with accounts that are not part of the same AWS Organizations.
+ There is no quota to limit how many pending invitations a receiving account can have.
+ Invitations are *not* used when sharing between accounts that are part of the same AWS Organizations and you've turned on resource sharing within the AWS Organizations. | 250 |

change_items.title: Service quota limit increase for pending invitations
change_items.summary: The maximum number of pending invitations per sharing account has been increased from 20 to 250.
change_items.quote: | [Service quota limit increase for pending invitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/service-quotas.html) | The maximum number of pending invitations per sharing account has been increased from 20 to 250. | June 8, 2023 |

change_items.title: AWS Systems Manager now supports sharing documents through AWS Resource Access Manager
change_items.summary: AWS Systems Manager now lets you share your Systems Manager Documents (SSM Documents) with an entire AWS organization or with specific organizational units (OUs) using AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM). Previously, you could only share a document publicly or with a list of individual account IDs. ...
